def VTask.subtypePreimage {α : Sort u} {β : Sort v} (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] (x₀ : {a // p a} → β) : {x // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀} ≃ ({a // ¬p a} → β) where
  toFun := λ ⟨x, hx⟩ => λ a => x a.val
  invFun := λ y => ⟨λ a, if h : p a then x₀ ⟨a, h⟩ else y ⟨a, h⟩, by intro a; simp [Subtype.val_eq_val]⟩
  left_inv := by
    intro y
    ext a
    cases a with
    | ⟨a, h⟩ => 
      simp [if_neg h]
      rfl
  right_inv := by
    intro ⟨x, hx⟩
    apply Subtype.eq
    ext a
    by_cases h : p a
    simp [h]
